course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Names change, customers remain: recognising the same record
goal: Use real catalog items to show that references establish identity and equal names do not merge customers.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P3. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: Two customers can share a name, and one customer can change their name. Linking requests by displayed text cannot distinguish these situations. Use two new records to see what outlasts a name.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Entity and key
paragraphs: A customer outlives one request. Its internal reference distinguishes it from another item even with the same name. An external code supports imports but needs its own uniqueness scope. Define which event creates a customer and which only updates the existing presentation.

The experiment creates two synthetic customers in a separate copy. The first is written, receives reference α, then changes name through the same object. A second object gets the same final name and a different reference β. Expect the original α after renaming and β≠α for the other item. These letters explain the trace and are not UUID values to enter. The check compares references rather than captions.

sections.title: The complete function: what happens to the data
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.
This is Данные.bsl for the common module. The separate application source below calls it. Do not paste both files into one editor.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: The first record gets its reference when saved. We then change the name on that same object. Another object gets another reference despite having the same final name. Neither the name nor the illustrative letter α is an actual UUID.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Normalization is not a business decision
paragraphs: Trimming spaces and case normalization can help compare codes but may collapse distinct identifiers. Normalized names do not prove identity. Define a unique teaching codeC001 and reject collisions with a different entity. Repeating an import must not increase item count.

In this configuration Код is a nine-character string with a scope different from the internal reference. One catalog’s code is not a universal global key. Integration identifiers require an agreed source and scope; normalizing names does not establish that agreement. The equal-name records are intentional test objects, not an automatic assertion that they are one customer.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: The second customer has the same name. Will their reference equal the first customer’s reference?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. СоздатьЭлемент creates another record. Reference equality tests identity; name equality tests text. Matching text performs no merge.

sections.title: References preserve relationships
paragraphs: A document stores a customer reference. Renaming should change presentation without breaking requests. Replacing the reference with a string loses relational identity and complicates updates. Key migration needs a mapping and checks of dependent objects; mass renaming alone is insufficient.

УчебныеДанные executes in the platform server context and is called by the managed application. In a file infobase that does not require a separate server computer. Server-call permission allows the 1C client to call an exported function; it neither publishes an internet HTTP endpoint nor replaces access rights. Leave privileged and global modes off.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The diagram uses letters to trace identity. Renaming preserves α; creating another element produces β. These are explanatory labels, not values to enter as real references.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Suppose СоздатьЭлемент is called again before renaming. The new name is saved, but on another reference. Compare the preserved reference before and after the edit; a plausible displayed name will not reveal the substitution.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: Verify idempotent creation
paragraphs: Seed twice and compare references, count and attributes. Add equal names with different codes to expose name-based lookup errors. Concurrent creation under one code needs a transactional solution; single-user repetition does not prove it. P10 addresses that boundary.

Every call creates two new items: this is a deliberate one-time experiment, not an idempotent customer import. Before repeating, record the created codes and expected growth. Do not use the original working base. The experiment distinguishes reference identity from names; merging records needs a separate rule and agreement.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: Create two new training services with one shared name. Give the first a rate of 600, then change that same object to 800. Give the second a rate of 900. Return four observations: the first reference is preserved, the references differ, and freshly read rates are 800 and 900. Preserve existing records and functions.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

sections.title: Where to run it and what to observe in 1C
paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.

sections.title: Limits of the observation and your explanation
paragraphs: The chosen training path is checked in a file infobase. This does not establish all permissions, bulk changes, network-server behaviour, or learner understanding. A run, a saved completion mark, and an explanation are separate facts.
Identify the source and scope of any external key; a matching name is not a merge rule.
